ns2:section.sectionText: VOCAL MUSIC IN THE AFRICAN-AMERICAN CONTEXT 3 credit hours Ollie-Watts-Davis, Professor http://www.music.uiuc.edu/facultyBio.php?id=24 A survey of the vocal music of African-Americans from the solo song to the gospel chorus. Vocal technique for jazz, Rhythm and Blues, and gospel music will be discussed, with particular attention given to text delivery, improvisation, and the extended use of the chest voice. The course will include a lecture and lab component. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
